description: National Broadband Network - Connections by Technology Type (Polygon) - July 2020 is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of the Commonwealth of Australia - Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development and Communications. This dataset presents the technology planned or delivered for premises or areas by NBN Co, and the availability of the NBN Co network at a premises. It provides data related to the technology type, service status and ready for service date at locations throughout the network. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Government of the Commonwealth of Australia - Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development and Communications. Its tags are Civil engineering, Communications engineering, Data communications, ENGINEERING, Infrastructure engineering. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2025-07-31 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-2.5-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
